reader.requirement: At --std 85 the RD's CONTROL clause must be accepted as CONTROL [IS] or CONTROLS [ARE] (IS/ARE optional, each bound to its own keyword) followed by either one or more data-name-1 or FINAL followed by zero or more data-name-1; data-name-1 is a 1985 'data-name' (§1985:III.2), so it may be qualified (SR1) but not subscripted or reference-modified, and FINAL may appear only once and only first.

reader.notes: The superset grammar (FINAL | dataReference)+ is narrowed by the binder's COBOL2421 screen; the 1985 operand class (data-name: qualified only) is enforced by the COBOL0900 gate for ref-mod and ControlOperandRef for subscripts. Minor: the subscript probe reports COBOL1699 twice for one fault. The COBOL0900 gate's doc comment says a subscripted control name is refused at every edition, which PB5602 made untrue at 2002 (not a 1985 defect).

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-004/ctl/k01.cob and k12.cob: RD R-1 CONTROL IS WS-IX with 01 WS-IX USAGE INDEX (and a TYPE CF WS-IX group) at --std 85 -> 'error COBOL1700: RD R-1: CONTROL operand WS-IX is an index data item ... (ISO §2023:13.18.60.3 SR10; a CONTROL clause naming it is an explicit reference, §2023:8.4.5)'; the same at --std 2023. The 1985 CONTROL clause names this operand class itself: cite.py 'OK §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR3b (3.7.4 General Rules) the text is in GR3b' for 'If the control data item is an index data item, the relation test is for the comparison of two index data items'. The refusal rests on the 2023 definition that a data-division clause is an explicit reference (§2023:8.4.5); 1985 defines explicit reference only for Procedure Division statements: cite.py 'OK §1985:IV.4.4.1 (4.4.1 Explicit and Implicit Procedure Division References) the text is in the clause' for 'An explicit reference occurs when the name of the referenced item is written in a Procedure Division statement', so §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5 (cite.py OK for 'An index data item can be referenced explicitly only in a SEARCH or SET statement') does not reach a Report Section CONTROL clause at 85. The rest held: k02 WS-A OF WS-G OF WS-TOP RAN; k03 F2-A IN F2-REC IN F2 (file-name qualifier) RAN; k06 F2-A OF F2 RAN; k11 group control RAN; k07 commas RAN; k10 CONTROL FINAL RAN; k04 condition-name and k05 index-name refused COBOL0899 (not data-names); k08 report-section item COBOL1699; k09 repeated WS-A COBOL1699 (§1985 SR2). ReportSectionBinder.cs#ControlOperandShapeViolation line 4824 carries no edition test.

adjudication.reason: An index data item as a CONTROL is refused at 85 (COBOL1700, citing a 2023 rule); `§1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR3b` provides for exactly that control, and 1985's limit on explicit references (`§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5`) is about Procedure Division statements (`§1985:IV.4.4.1`). I ran it.
